overview: The Medford City Council held a public hearing on the FY22 CDBG Action Plan, approved CPA funding for emergency rental assistance, and discussed sidewalk maintenance, construction impacts, and council budget authority. It also referred a proposal to establish a Municipal Youth Commission to a committee of the whole.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Health Update
items.summary: Board of Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor reported on regional vaccination clinics, declining case rates, student vaccination plans, and field permit safety procedures.

items.title: Public Hearing on CDBG FY22 Annual Action Plan
items.summary: The council held a public hearing and approved the application to submit the annual action plan for $1,546,980 in federal Community Development Block Grant funds.

items.title: DPW Infrastructure and Maintenance Requests
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting DPW address specific potholes, sidewalk trip hazards, and a abandoned bicycle frame.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Commendations
items.summary: The council approved resolutions celebrating the 90th birthday of Rita Lennox and the 80th birthday of Nancy White, congratulating Max Hennig on a poetry book award, and honoring Detective Lieutenant Richard Mahoney on his retirement.

items.title: Request for Department Head Appointment Letters
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide copies of appointment letters for the City Solicitor, HR/Diversity Director, and Community Development Director.

items.title: Water Meter Monitoring and System Status Reports
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting reports on whether the city monitors water usage exception reports to catch leaks and the current status of aging water meters.

items.title: City Council Budget Authority Discussion
items.summary: Approved a motion to seek a formal legal opinion from the City Solicitor and hold a committee meeting to clarify the council's line-item cut authority during the budget process.

items.title: Mystic Street Parking and Construction Mitigation
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the Traffic Commission review permit parking on Mystic Street and demanding utility contractors remove construction plates and equipment from public grounds.

items.title: Municipal Youth Commission Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: Referred to the Committee of the Whole a proposal to accept state statute enabling the creation of a Medford Youth Commission.

items.title: CPA Funding for Emergency Rental Assistance
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $62,500 in CPA General Reserve funds for Action for Boston Community Development to complete its emergency rental assistance program.

items.title: Status Update on El Tacuba Restaurant
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a status update on the opening of El Tacuba and upcoming events at Chevalier Theatre.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: The council accepted reports from previous committee meetings covering job classification reviews, housing stability, and sidewalk snow removal plans.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: President Caraviello ruled Joseph Viglione's public participation request out of order under council rules and referred the matter to executive session.
